facts.fact: The SIREC page says the system, funded by the EU and implemented by the Direcao-Geral de Identificacao Civil, Registos e Notariado, processes civil registration data including births in a single integrated database.
The SIREC page says the system registers deaths (obito) alongside births and marriages, with fully digital storage of registration acts.

systems.owner: Direcao-Geral de Identificacao Civil, Registos e Notariado
